title: Lessons were never grouped into clusters
problem: A new cluster was linked to lessons before it was saved, so every grouping pass failed on the foreign key and lessons waited forever.
fix: The cluster is saved first, grouping locks new lessons with skip locked and commits before naming them.

title: A passing proof ended as an error
problem: The proof finish lazy-loaded a timestamp after an update, so every passing proof showed The proof stopped with an error.
fix: Proposals load server defaults eagerly and passing proofs finish as passed.

title: Proofs could run far past the daily budget
problem: One automatic proof spent 1.79M tokens against a 400k budget and automatic proposals blocked people's requests.
fix: Automatic proposals use at most half the budget, people's proposals go first and a running proof stops when the day is spent.

title: Rollback and release notices never reached anyone
problem: Notifications were written after the caller's commit and never committed.
fix: Notices commit on their own and reach the approver and the owner.

title: A thumbs down then a correction made two lessons
problem: The thumbs lesson was grouped before the correction arrived.
fix: The correction revises the same lesson and a switch to thumbs up takes it out of its group.

title: Edit history and live edits were not reliable
problem: Healing patches, publish and import wrote no revision, a failed revision write was swallowed, and live agents could be edited without the eval gate.
fix: Every change path writes a revision with its source, failures stop the change, and the gate runs on live edits and healing patches.

title: Trajectory recall never found anything
problem: The runtime read one folder while Wingman wrote another, recall ignored success, and polling wrote duplicates.
fix: One shared folder, ranking by outcome and one file per execution.

title: Pipeline inputs showed as raw JSON
problem: Runs store their input as an object, which showed as JSON on Executions and Moderation.
fix: Inputs are shown as words on the runs list, the run page and moderation events.

title: Start here chat steps opened an empty chat
problem: The follow-up and feedback steps linked to a blank chat with no answer to rate.
fix: They open the member's latest conversation.
